message.shatter_gui.no_favorites: Add favourite effects in the settings (★ on the Effects tab)
screen.shatter_gui.title: Shatter GUI settings
ui.shatter_gui.title: Shatter GUI
ui.shatter_gui.subtitle: How interfaces appear and disappear
ui.shatter_gui.too_small: The window is too small for the settings (at least %s×%s interface pixels are needed). Make the window bigger or lower the GUI scale in the video settings. Esc closes.
ui.shatter_gui.reset.tooltip: Back to the value the mod comes with.
ui.shatter_gui.reset_all.tooltip: Back to the defaults for all settings of this effect.
ui.shatter_gui.tab.general.desc: What happens when you open and close an interface, style, performance.
ui.shatter_gui.tab.effects.desc: Each effect on its own: duration, strength, number of particles.
ui.shatter_gui.tab.screens.desc: A different effect for single screens: chests, furnaces, inventory…
ui.shatter_gui.tab.custom.desc: Your own effects: made in the editor or based on the built-in ones.
ui.shatter_gui.preview.mode.open.desc: The preview plays how this effect opens an interface (backwards).
ui.shatter_gui.preview.mode.close.desc: The preview plays how this effect closes an interface.
ui.shatter_gui.preview.mode.both.desc: The preview opens the interface with this effect, holds it a moment and closes it with the same effect.
ui.shatter_gui.preview.no_open: “%s” has no opening: the interface would just appear. Choose “Closing” to see the effect.
ui.shatter_gui.preview.pick_screen: Pick a screen from the list
ui.shatter_gui.preview.no_world: The in-world preview needs a loaded world
ui.shatter_gui.autoplay.tooltip: Play the preview in a loop and again after every change.
ui.shatter_gui.in_world.tooltip: Hide the settings and show the real effect in the game with the unsaved values.
ui.shatter_gui.general.title: Shatter GUI
ui.shatter_gui.general.desc: The mod animates interfaces: how they appear when you open them and how they disappear when you close them.
ui.shatter_gui.enabled.desc: Turn off to make the mod do nothing — interfaces then work as in the normal game.
ui.shatter_gui.open.title: When you open an interface
ui.shatter_gui.open.desc: What happens when you open a chest, a furnace, an anvil or another block.
ui.shatter_gui.open.none.desc: The interface opens right away, as in the normal game.
ui.shatter_gui.open.fly_from_block.desc: The interface flies out of the block or creature you opened and grows into place.
ui.shatter_gui.close.title: When you close an interface
ui.shatter_gui.close.desc: How the interface disappears when you close it. Single screens can get something else in the Screens tab.
ui.shatter_gui.preset.title: Effect style
ui.shatter_gui.preset.desc: The overall strength of all effects at once.
ui.shatter_gui.playback.title: Playback
ui.shatter_gui.always_on_top.desc: Effects are drawn after the world, so blocks in front never cut into them; the HUD and screens stay on top.
ui.shatter_gui.performance.title: Performance
ui.shatter_gui.performance.desc: Lower these if the game stutters during effects.
ui.shatter_gui.quality.desc: How many pieces and particles effects make; low also skips block collisions, glow and texture overlays.
ui.shatter_gui.quality.low.desc: Fewer pieces and particles, no collisions, glow or overlays.
ui.shatter_gui.max_concurrent.desc: How many effects may play at the same time, openings and closes with their particles together.
ui.shatter_gui.policy.desc: What happens when a new effect would go over the limit.
ui.shatter_gui.policy.finish_oldest.desc: Older effects end quickly (about 0.2 s) and the new one plays.
ui.shatter_gui.policy.skip_new.desc: The new effect does not play; the interface just opens or closes.
ui.shatter_gui.access.title: Accessibility
ui.shatter_gui.reduce_motion.desc: Calmer effects: shorter, no flicker or sudden moves, fewer particles.
ui.shatter_gui.where.title: Where it works
ui.shatter_gui.apply_to.all.desc: Any interface in the world: chests, inventory, chat, pause menu…
ui.shatter_gui.apply_to.containers.desc: Only chests, furnaces, the inventory and other screens with slots.
ui.shatter_gui.look.title: Settings look
ui.shatter_gui.look.desc: The accent colour of this window.
ui.shatter_gui.about.title: About
ui.shatter_gui.about.author: Author: %s
ui.shatter_gui.about.modrinth.tooltip: Opens the mod's page on Modrinth; the game asks before opening the browser.
ui.shatter_gui.about.curseforge.tooltip: Opens the mod's page on CurseForge; the game asks before opening the browser.
ui.shatter_gui.about.github.tooltip: Opens the source code on GitHub; the game asks before opening the browser.
ui.shatter_gui.about.report_bug.tooltip: Opens the issue tracker on GitHub; please give the game and mod versions, your mod list, latest.log and the steps.
ui.shatter_gui.about.translations: English and Ukrainian are written by hand. German, Spanish, French, Portuguese (Brazil), Polish, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Japanese, Korean and Italian are machine-assisted and need review by native speakers. To send a correction, open an issue or a pull request with the changed language file on the mod's source page.
ui.shatter_gui.about.third_party: Inspired by Spatial GUI by tastytrash (MIT); no code from it is included. Works with Iris (LGPL-3.0) through its public API. Details: NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY.md.
ui.shatter_gui.real_preview.desc: What the previews break: the real vanilla screens (inventory, chest, furnace, crafting table) or simple drawn samples. Real needs a world; on any error the simple samples are used.
ui.shatter_gui.real_preview.real.desc: The real vanilla screens, drawn off-screen.
ui.shatter_gui.real_preview.simple.desc: Simple drawn samples: lighter, and they work without a world.
ui.shatter_gui.effects.title: Effects
ui.shatter_gui.effects.desc: Pick an effect to adjust it. The miniatures show each effect with the current values.
ui.shatter_gui.assign.hint: Select a card, then choose below what to use it for. Double-click a card to use it for opening and closing. ★ marks favourites: the “Next favourite effect” key switches between them.
ui.shatter_gui.assign.open.tooltip: Interfaces open with this effect played backwards: the pieces gather into the interface.
ui.shatter_gui.assign.open.none.tooltip: This effect has no opening: it can only be used when interfaces close.
ui.shatter_gui.assign.close.tooltip: Interfaces break apart with this effect when they close.
ui.shatter_gui.assign.both.tooltip: Interfaces open with this effect backwards and close with it forwards.
ui.shatter_gui.assign.remove.tooltip: Stop using this effect: opening goes back to “Just appears”, closing to Glass.
ui.shatter_gui.assign.confirm.title: Use for both?
ui.shatter_gui.assign.confirm.close_only: “%s” has no opening. Use it when interfaces close?
ui.shatter_gui.favorite.tooltip: Click to mark this effect as a favourite. The “Next favourite effect” key switches the close effect between favourites.
ui.shatter_gui.badge.title: In use
ui.shatter_gui.badge.tooltip: “Opening”: interfaces open with this effect. “Closing”: they close with it. Change it with the buttons under the selected card.
ui.shatter_gui.effects.custom_note: This is a custom effect based on “%s”. The values below change only it.
ui.shatter_gui.effects.pack_note: This effect comes from a resource pack. You can clone it in the Custom tab.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.glass.desc: The interface breaks like glass: shards fly apart, spin, fall and bounce off the ground.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.burn.desc: The interface catches fire at the bottom: it yellows, glows, chars and crumbles, with flames, sparks and smoke.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.fly.desc: The interface shrinks and flies back into the block you opened it from. Without one it leaves through an edge of the screen.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.dissolve.desc: A wave runs over the interface and it falls apart into little squares that glow and drift upwards.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.vortex.desc: The shards spiral around, turn violet and vanish in a single point.
ui.shatter_gui.screens.title: Screens
ui.shatter_gui.screens.desc: Every screen the mod has seen so far. Each can get its own effect or none.
ui.shatter_gui.screens.none: No screens yet. Open a chest, a furnace or your inventory in the game and it will show up here.
ui.shatter_gui.screens.as_general.desc: Whatever is chosen in the General tab.
ui.shatter_gui.screens.off.desc: This screen disappears without an effect.
ui.shatter_gui.custom.title: Custom effects
ui.shatter_gui.custom.desc: Make your own effect as a copy of any other and change its values. Share it as a code.
ui.shatter_gui.custom.none: No custom effects yet. Pick an effect above and press Create, or import a code.
ui.shatter_gui.custom.create.tooltip: A new custom effect as a copy of the chosen one (a built-in one with your current values).
ui.shatter_gui.custom.import.tooltip: Add an effect from a code in the clipboard (checked first).
ui.shatter_gui.custom.export.tooltip: Copy the effect as a code to the clipboard to share it.
ui.shatter_gui.custom.delete.confirm: “%s” will be deleted when you save. This cannot be undone.
ui.shatter_gui.custom.name: Name
ui.shatter_gui.custom.name.tooltip: Shown in every list of effects (the technical name %s stays the same).
ui.shatter_gui.custom.reset.tooltip: Drop this effect's own values: everything comes from the base effect's settings again.
ui.shatter_gui.custom.later: Particles and sounds of a classic custom effect are changed in its file. For full control, make an effect in the effect editor.
ui.shatter_gui.discard.title: Discard changes?
ui.shatter_gui.discard.message: You changed settings but did not save them. If you close now, the changes are lost.
param.shatter_gui.general.particleDensit: How many flames, smoke puffs, sparks and other bits all effects make. 0: no particles at all.
param.shatter_gui.general.effectSpeed.to: How many times faster all effects play. Higher means shorter effects.
param.shatter_gui.general.openSpeed.tool: How many times faster interfaces gather when they open. Only openings; Effect speed still applies too.
param.shatter_gui.general.soundVolume.to: Overall volume of the mod's sounds.
param.shatter_gui.general.maxShards.tool: How many shards can exist at once; beyond that old ones vanish. Lower it if the game stutters.
param.shatter_gui.glass.columns.tooltip: How many pieces the interface breaks into horizontally.
param.shatter_gui.glass.rows.tooltip: How many pieces the interface breaks into vertically.
param.shatter_gui.glass.lifetime.tooltip: After how long the shards disappear.
param.shatter_gui.glass.fadeStart.toolti: From which part of their life the shards start fading out.
param.shatter_gui.glass.airDrag.tooltip: How much of its speed a shard keeps each moment. Lower: shards slow down sooner.
param.shatter_gui.glass.burst.tooltip: How far the shards fly apart.
param.shatter_gui.glass.bounce.tooltip: How much speed is left after hitting the ground.
param.shatter_gui.glass.fullbright.toolt: On: shards are as bright as the interface; off: lit like the world around them.
param.shatter_gui.burn.duration.tooltip: How long the fire takes from the bottom to the top.
param.shatter_gui.burn.smokeDuration.too: How long smoke keeps rising after the interface has burnt.
param.shatter_gui.burn.flameDensity.tool: How many flames, embers and sparks.
param.shatter_gui.burn.smokeDensity.tool: How much smoke from the fire and smouldering spots. 0: no smoke.
param.shatter_gui.fly.duration.tooltip: How long the interface takes to fly out of the block and back.
param.shatter_gui.fly.edgeDirection.tool: Where an interface not opened from a block (like the inventory) flies in from and out to.
param.shatter_gui.dissolve.duration.tool: How long the wave takes to cross the interface. Each square then drifts up for ~0.6 s.
param.shatter_gui.dissolve.origin.toolti: Where the interface starts falling apart.
param.shatter_gui.dissolve.pixelSize.too: Side of a square in interface pixels.
How long the whole vortex takes until the last shard vanishes in the point.
param.shatter_gui.vortex.spiralTurns.too: How many times the shards go around the point.
param.shatter_gui.vortex.pullStrength.to: How hard the point pulls: higher means the shards close in sooner.
param.shatter_gui.vortex.spinSpeed.toolt: How fast each shard turns on its own. 0: not at all.
param.shatter_gui.vortex.targetPoint.too: The point the shards vanish in. “The block” without a source block works like “In front of the player”.
param.shatter_gui.vortex.soundVolume.too: Portal hum as the vortex starts.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.data.desc: An effect made in the effect editor (or from a file): its own way of breaking, motion layers, look and particles.
ui.shatter_gui.custom.reload.tooltip: Read effects, .shatterfx packages and textures again from config/shatter_gui and resource packs.
ui.shatter_gui.custom.export_package: An effect with textures is shared as a .shatterfx package, not a code
ui.shatter_gui.data.title: Editor effects
ui.shatter_gui.data.desc: Effects made in the effect editor or described by an effect.json file (see docs/EFFECT_FORMAT.md). Put a .json in config/shatter_gui/effects or a .shatterfx package in config/shatter_gui/packages and press Reload.
ui.shatter_gui.data.edit_note: Effects from the config folder are edited in the effect editor (Custom tab); a package or resource-pack effect can be imported or copied there.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.small.title: The effect editor needs more room
ui.shatter_gui.fx.small.desc: Open it on the whole screen (a smaller GUI scale also helps), or edit the classic effects here.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.classic.title: Classic custom effects
ui.shatter_gui.fx.classic.desc: A built-in effect with your own settings, particles and sounds: the older, simpler way. Effects from scratch are made in the effect editor.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.add.desc: Add a layer (a module that moves pieces), particles or a sound.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.row.tooltip: Click to edit, drag to reorder, double click to rename. Eye: turn it on or off.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.top.effects.desc: Open another of your effects, start a new one, duplicate or delete this one.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.top.save.desc: Writes the effect to config/shatter_gui/effects/<id>.json and reloads the effects (Ctrl+S). A dot means unsaved changes.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.top.redo.desc: Redo what was undone (Ctrl+Y or Ctrl+Shift+Z).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.top.test.desc: Plays the effect as it is now in the world, on this window; the editor comes back afterwards. Needs a world.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.top.export.desc: Saves a .shatterfx package (the effect and its textures) to config/shatter_gui/exports. Without textures the code also goes to the clipboard.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.top.import.desc: Imports a .shatterfx package or an effect code from the clipboard.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.top.classic.desc: Classic custom effects: a built-in effect with your own settings, particles and sounds. Simpler than the editor; effects made before it live here.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.top.fullscreen.desc: Switches between the editor on the whole screen and inside the settings. Nothing is lost.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.menu.delete.title: Delete the effect?
ui.shatter_gui.fx.menu.delete.message: The file effects/%s.json is deleted. Textures stay in the textures folder.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.leave.title: Unsaved changes
ui.shatter_gui.fx.leave.message: This effect has unsaved changes. Continue without saving them?
ui.shatter_gui.fx.left.layers.desc: The effect's parts: settings, look, layers, particles, sounds.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.left.textures.desc: The PNGs in config/shatter_gui/textures, for sprites, overlays and masks.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.part.effect.desc: Name, duration, how the interface breaks and in which order the pieces start.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.part.appearance.desc: Colour, transparency, glow, overlaid textures and a mask.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.part.edge.desc: Everything flies in from an edge of the screen at the start, or out through one at the end.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.catalog.title: Add to the effect
ui.shatter_gui.fx.catalog.particles.desc: Spawns Minecraft particles (flame, smoke, sparks…) from the pieces, the edge or a point.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.catalog.sprites.desc: Particles drawn with your own PNG, with colour, size and transparency over their life.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.catalog.sound.desc: Plays a game sound at the start, the end or any moment of the effect.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.stay.desc: Holds the pieces where they are while the layer is active.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.launch.desc: Pushes the pieces away from a point, with some spread.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.gravity.desc: Pulls the pieces down (or up, with a negative strength).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.drag.desc: Slows the pieces down, as if in thick air.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.attract.desc: Pulls the pieces to a point, optionally in a spiral, and can swallow them there.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.drift.desc: Lets the pieces wander gently, like leaves or ash.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.spin.desc: Turns the pieces and tumbles them over.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.scale.desc: Makes the pieces bigger or smaller over time.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.follow-path.des: Moves the pieces along a smooth curve through a few points.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.launch.speed.des: How fast the pieces are pushed away.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.launch.spread.de: Random change of direction: 0 is straight away from the point.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.launch.out.desc: Extra speed towards the camera (negative: away from it).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.drag.amount.desc: How much speed and spin is lost every tick.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.attract.strength: How hard the pieces are pulled; negative pushes them away.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.attract.swirl.de: Circling around the point: a spiral instead of a straight pull. The sign gives the direction.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.attract.absorb.d: Pieces closer than this (share of the interface size) shrink to nothing.
How quickly the wandering changes direction.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.drift.out.desc: Wandering towards and away from the camera too.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.spin.tumble.desc: Flipping over around an axis in the plane.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.scale.value.desc: 1 is the original size, 0 nothing, 2 twice as big.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.follow-path.prog: Where on the path the pieces are: 0 at the start, 100 % at the last point.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.form.number.desc: One value, the same all the time.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.form.random.desc: Each piece gets its own value between two numbers.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.form.curve.desc: From one value to another over time, with an easing preset.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.form.bezier.desc: From one value to another along a curve you shape with two handles.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.form.keys.desc: Values at chosen moments, blended in between.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.value.jitter.desc: Each piece gets the value ± this share, so they do not all move alike.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.value.keys_hint: Click: add a key · drag: move · right click: remove
ui.shatter_gui.fx.value.timeline.desc: Edit this curve's keyframes under the timeline, over the layer's time window.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.inspector.cannot_show: These settings cannot be shown (%s). Undo the last change or fix the file.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.id.desc: The file name and the name in the settings: a-z, 0-9 and _, up to 32 characters.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.name: Name
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.duration.desc: How long the whole effect takes (the player's speed settings still apply).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.fracture_mode.de: How the interface is cut into pieces.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.sectors.desc: Pieces around the centre in each ring.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.segments.desc: Each strip is cut into this many parts.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.pixel_size.desc: Side of a square piece in interface pixels.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.cols.desc: An exact grid instead of the count (0: from the count).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.rows.desc: An exact grid instead of the count (0: from the count).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.split.desc: Each grid cell becomes two triangular pieces.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.region.desc: Cut only this area finely; the rest becomes a few big pieces (group “Outside”).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.trigger_from.des: The point the front spreads out from.
A grey picture: dark parts start first, light ones last.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.spread.desc: Share of the duration it takes the front to pass: 0 is all at once.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.trigger_noise.de: Adds noise to the order, so the front is not a clean line.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.color.desc: Multiplied with the picture over each piece's life. Click the bar to add a stop.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.color_time.desc: Each piece's own life, or the whole effect.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.alpha.desc: Over each piece's life; it is removed when its life ends.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.emissive.desc: Light of its own (not darkened by the world).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.emissive_color.d: Colour of the glow over each piece's life.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.fullbright.desc: Pieces are not shaded when they turn.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.overlay.title: Overlay %s
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.texture.desc: A PNG from the texture library.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.texture.role.spr: A PNG up to %s×%s pixels, from the texture library.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.texture.role.ove: A PNG up to %s×%s pixels, from the texture library.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.texture.role.mas: A grey PNG up to %s×%s pixels, from the texture library.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.blend.desc: How the texture mixes with the pieces.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.overlay_color.de: Colour the texture is multiplied with.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.scroll.desc: How far the texture moves per second (U across, V down).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.repeat.desc: How many times the texture fits across and down the interface.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.mask_on.desc: Pieces where the mask is darker than the threshold disappear.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.threshold.desc: Over time: raise it to let the mask eat the interface.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.softness.desc: How gradual the mask's edge is.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.edge.off: Off: the pieces stay on the screen.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.edge_exit.desc: Everything flies out through the edge.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.exit_start.desc: Share of the effect after which leaving starts.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.edge_enter.desc: Everything flies in from the edge first.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.enter_time.desc: Share of the effect the coming in takes.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.item_name.desc: Only for you, in the editor.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.enabled.desc: Off: stays in the effect but does nothing.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.module.desc: What this layer does. Changing it resets its settings.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.time_base.desc: Each piece's own life (striped on the timeline) or the whole effect.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.from.desc: Share of the time when the layer begins (also: drag the bar's left end).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.to.desc: Share of the time when the layer stops (also: drag the bar's right end).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.launch_from.desc: The point the pieces are pushed away from.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.once.desc: On: a single push when the layer starts. Off: a force all the time.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.attract_to.desc: The point the pieces are pulled to.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.world.desc: On: down in the world. Off: down along the interface (matters on a tilted Spatial GUI screen).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.path.offset.desc: From where the piece was, in interface widths: X right, Y down, Z towards you.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.emitter.vanilla_note: Vanilla particles keep their own colour and life; size, speed and gravity apply.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.sprite.desc: The PNG each particle is drawn with (always faces the camera).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.particle.desc: Particles without options from the game (and mods).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.emit_from.desc: Share of the effect when spawning begins.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.emit_to.desc: Share of the effect when spawning stops.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.rate.desc: Particles per second over the spawning time (a curve gives waves of particles).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.burst.desc: Particles all at once when spawning starts.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.line_to.desc: The other end of the line.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.velocity.desc: X right, Y up, Z towards you.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.emit_spread.desc: Random extra speed in any direction.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.size.desc: Over a particle's life, in blocks.
On: light is added (bright, no shading). Off: plain transparency.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.max.desc: Most of these particles alive at once.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.sound.desc: Any sound of the game (and mods).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.sound.listen.desc: Plays the sound with this volume and pitch.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.sound.unknown: The game does not know this sound.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.volume.desc: Multiplied with the mod's sound volume.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.moment.desc: At the start, at the end or at a chosen moment (also: drag its diamond on the timeline).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.fracture.grid.desc: Rows and columns of slightly crooked pieces.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.fracture.radial.desc: Rings and sectors around a centre, like a dartboard.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.trigger.none.desc: Every piece starts at the same moment.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.trigger.wave.desc: A front moves across the interface in one direction.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.trigger.radial.desc: The front spreads out from a point in rings.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.trigger.noise.desc: Random patches start first, like burning paper.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.trigger.mask.desc: Your own grey picture decides: dark first, light last.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.trigger.random.desc: Each piece starts at a random moment.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.time.local.desc: Measured from each piece's start to its end.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.time.global.desc: Measured over the whole effect, the same for all pieces.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.blend.multiply.desc: Multiplies (burn marks, wet stains). With shader packs drawn as normal.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.edge_dir.left.desc: The left edge of the screen.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.edge_dir.right.desc: The right edge of the screen.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.edge_dir.top.desc: The top edge of the screen.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.edge_dir.bottom.desc: The bottom edge of the screen.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.zone.surface.desc: From the pieces that are moving.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.zone.line.desc: Anywhere on a line between two points.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.point.source.desc: The block the interface was opened from (else: in front of the player).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.point.player.desc: Just in front of the player's eyes.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.point.fixed.desc: A spot on the interface (shares of its width and height).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.target.wave.desc: Pieces in a part of the order: those that start early, late, …

ui.shatter_gui.fx.target.region.desc: Pieces of the finely cut part (Breaking → Only a part).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.target.outside.desc: The big pieces around the region.

ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.scrub.desc: Click or drag to see any moment (pauses). The mark is the effect's end; after it, particles finish.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.speed.desc: Play slower or faster (the effect itself is not changed).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.sample.desc: Which interface breaks in the preview.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.opening.desc: Play the effect backwards, as it opens an interface (shorter: the opening speed applies).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.real.desc: Click to switch between the real vanilla screens and the simple drawn samples (for this session; the setting is in General).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.real.no_world: Real screens need a loaded world; the simple samples are shown until then.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.real.failed: The real screens could not be drawn, so the simple samples are shown (details in the log).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.errors: %s errors: the preview shows the last valid state. See the red fields.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.errors_none: %s errors: nothing to play yet. See the red fields.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.preview.mask_missing: The mask texture is missing: random patches are used instead.

ui.shatter_gui.fx.timeline.empty: Add layers, particles or sounds: they appear here as tracks.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.timeline.curve_hint: click: key · drag · right click: remove
ui.shatter_gui.fx.textures.import.desc: Opens the textures folder: put PNG files there (overlays and masks up to %s px, sprites up to %s px, at most %s KB each). The library picks them up by itself.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.textures.empty: No textures yet. Import opens the folder: drop PNG files there.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.textures.as_sprite.des: Use it for the particles of the selected emitter (or a new one). Up to %s px.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.textures.as_overlay.de: Add it as a texture laid over the pieces.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.textures.as_trigger.de: Use it as the mask that decides which pieces start first.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.textures.as_mask.desc: Use it as the look's mask (pieces disappear where it is dark).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.textures.tiles.desc: Show it repeated, to see how a mask tiles.

ui.shatter_gui.fx.template.glass.desc: Shards burst from the centre, fall and tumble.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.template.burn.desc: Burns away in patches: glow, ash, flames and smoke.

ui.shatter_gui.fx.template.vortex.desc: Spirals into the centre, glows violet and vanishes.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.template.rain.desc: Rain falls from above while strips slide down.

ui.shatter_gui.fx.tour.layers.text: Settings and look at the top, then layers: each moves some pieces at some time. Add opens the catalogue. The eye turns a layer on or off, drag to reorder, double click to rename. Textures are in the second tab.

ui.shatter_gui.fx.tour.preview.text: Every change shows here at once. Space pauses, the time bar scrubs; choose the speed and the sample interface below.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.tour.timeline.title: Timeline
ui.shatter_gui.fx.tour.timeline.text: Each layer is a bar: drag it, or its ends, to change when it acts. Curves of settings can be shown here and their keyframes dragged.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.tour.inspector.title: Inspector
ui.shatter_gui.fx.tour.inspector.text: Everything about what you selected. Numbers can become curves; red text under a field says what is wrong. Ctrl+Z undoes, Ctrl+S saves.

ui.shatter_gui.effect.frost.desc: Ice creeps in from the edges to the centre; each frozen piece then cracks off and falls.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.sand.desc: Crumbles into grains of sand that the wind blows away to the side.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.portal.desc: A purple vortex pulls the pieces into the middle, with ender portal particles.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.runes.desc: Breaks into glowing squares like enchanting glyphs that rise and fade.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.lightning.desc: Sparks run along the edges, then each piece breaks off with one short flash. At most three flashes a second.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.glitch.desc: Strips and blocks jump sideways and flicker in split colours. With “Reduce motion” they only slide apart and fade, without flicker.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.paper.desc: Folds up in strips like paper and flies off up and away.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.tiles.desc: Comes apart in square tiles that pop loose one by one and fall.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.explosion.desc: A white-hot flash and a shock wave throw the pieces outwards, with sparks but no smoke.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.confetti.desc: Bursts into colourful confetti that flutters down, with a little firework.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.bubbles.desc: Pieces turn into bubbles that float up, wobble and pop, as in a brewing stand.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.soul_fire.desc: Burns away in cold blue flames while souls rise from the ashes.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.pixelate.desc: The picture coarsens into big pixels, which then crumble away from the top.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.blinds.desc: Horizontal slats slide out, every other one to the opposite side.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.pop.desc: Squeezes into a dot and is gone, with a soft pop.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.slide.desc: Slides off to the side with a slight tilt.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.flip.desc: Turns about its vertical axis like a card and vanishes edge-on.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.recede.desc: Sinks away towards the horizon, leaning back and darkening, down to a speck.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.door.desc: Swings about 100° open on hinges at its left edge, away from you, strip by strip.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.ripple.desc: A wave crosses the interface; the pieces rise from it and float away.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.twirl.desc: Spins around its centre faster and faster as it shrinks away.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.drop.desc: Falls in one piece, hits the ground and breaks into four.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.accordion.desc: Folds up into strips like an accordion, towards the middle.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.peel.desc: A corner curls up and the whole interface peels away like a sticker.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.spring.desc: Squashes down like a spring, then shoots up out of sight.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.tear.desc: Rips in half like paper; the halves fly apart.
ui.shatter_gui.effect.iris.desc: The edges close in towards the middle like a camera iris.
ui.shatter_gui.themes.rule.lectern.desc: Reading a book on a lectern.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.tumble_axis.desc: The line in the interface the pieces tumble about: 0° right, 90° up (turns like a card). Not set: each piece has its own random axis.
param.shatter_gui.bundled.duration.toolt: How long the effect takes from start to end.

ui.shatter_gui.effects.bundled_note: Comes with the mod. To change more than these settings, copy it into your own effects and edit the copy.
ui.shatter_gui.effects.bundled_note.open: Comes with the mod. It can also open interfaces (General → When you open an interface). To change more than these settings, copy it into your own effects.
ui.shatter_gui.effects.clone.tooltip: Opens a copy in the effect editor (Custom tab) to change and save as your own. The original stays as it is.
ui.shatter_gui.open.data.desc: The interface gathers from the pieces of “%s”: the close effect played backwards.
ui.shatter_gui.open.data.missing: This effect is not loaded: the interface just opens.
ui.shatter_gui.open.effect.burn.desc: Burning played backwards: ash turns into charred pieces, they glow and become the interface, from the top down. No smoke.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.force.desc: Pushes the pieces the same way every tick, like wind.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.force.x.desc: Push to the right (negative: to the left).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.force.z.desc: Push towards the camera (negative: away from it).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.module.collide.desc: Pieces land on blocks and bounce off walls instead of falling through them. Add it together with gravity.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.collide.bounce.d: How much speed is left after hitting a block. 0: no bounce, 100 %: bounces back as fast as it came.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.param.collide.friction: How much sideways speed a piece loses each time it touches the ground. More: it stops sooner.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.field.rest.desc: What a piece does once it lies still on a block.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.rest.lie.desc: The piece stays on the ground until its time is over.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.rest.fade.desc: The piece fades out within half a second of coming to rest.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.target.alternate.desc: Every second piece in cutting order: alternate strips or tiles.
ui.shatter_gui.thematic.desc: Each kind of interface closes in its own way: a furnace burns, an enchanting table breaks into runes, an ender chest disappears into a portal. Others use the effect above. Change the table in the Screens tab.

ui.shatter_gui.themes.on: Thematic mode is on: these interfaces close with the effect chosen here. A choice for a single screen above still comes first.

ui.shatter_gui.themes.rule.containers.de: Chests, barrels, shulker boxes and other storage.

ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.title: Help
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.button.desc: Short pages about layers, targets, time and curves, the timeline, textures, particles, limits and sharing.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.close.desc: Closes the help (Esc does the same).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.layers.title: Layers
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.layers.text: An effect is a stack of layers. Each layer is one module (launch, gravity, spin, collide…) that acts on some pieces during part of their time. Layers add up from top to bottom: a launch gives a push, gravity pulls it down, collide stops it at the floor. The eye turns a layer off without deleting it; drag a layer to change the order.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.targets.title: Targets
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.targets.text: A target decides which pieces a layer moves: all of them, those in a part of the wave, those near the edge, a random share, the region you marked, or every other one. "Invert" takes the rest. Give two layers opposite targets to make half the pieces fly and the other half fall.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.timing.title: Time and curves
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.timing.text: Pieces do not all start at once: the trigger spreads their start over the effect (a wave, from a point, by noise). Each layer acts in a window "from–to" of a piece's own time (local) or of the whole effect (global). A number can be a curve over that window: it eases from one value to another, so a push can fade or a spin can speed up.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.timeline.title: Timeline
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.timeline.text: The timeline under the preview shows every layer, emitter and sound as a bar over time. Drag a bar's ends to change its window, click the ruler to jump to a moment, and use "show on the timeline" next to a number to edit its curve right there. Space plays and pauses.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.textures.title: Textures
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.textures.text: Put PNG files into the effect's texture folder (the second tab on the left opens it). An overlay paints a texture over the pieces (normal, additive or multiply), a mask decides by brightness where pieces show, and a sprite is the picture of your own particles. Sprites are at most 256 px, overlays and masks 512 px, all together 2 MB.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.particles.title: Particles
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.particles.text: An emitter makes particles while the effect runs: vanilla ones (flame, smoke, end rod…) or your own sprites. Choose where they appear (the pieces, the edge, the front of the wave, a point or a line), how many per second, a burst at the start, and their speed, life, gravity and size. The particle density setting scales them all.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.limits.title: Limits
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.limits.text: So that no effect can slow the game down, there are hard limits: up to 1500 pieces and 3000 triangles, 16 layers, 8 emitters, 400 own particles per effect and 1200 in all, 20 seconds. Collisions check at most 600 pieces per effect and 4000 blocks per tick; pieces at rest are not checked. The counters at the bottom show how close you are.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.sharing.title: Sharing an effect
ui.shatter_gui.fx.help.sharing.text: Export saves a .shatterfx package (the effect and its textures) into the exports folder; send that file to a friend, who drops it into the packages folder or uses Import. An effect without textures can also be copied as a short code and pasted with "Import from clipboard".
ui.shatter_gui.save.tooltip: Saves every change and closes the settings.
ui.shatter_gui.cancel.tooltip: Closes the settings without saving (asks first if something changed). Esc does the same.
ui.shatter_gui.section.fold: Click (or Enter) to fold this card; the choice is kept until the game closes.
ui.shatter_gui.section.unfold: Click (or Enter) to unfold this card and see its settings.
ui.shatter_gui.screens.by_mod.tooltip: Shows only the screens of one mod (or of Minecraft itself).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.item.duplicate.desc: Adds a copy of this item right below it.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.item.delete.desc: Removes this item from the effect (Ctrl+Z brings it back).
ui.shatter_gui.fx.edge.disable.desc: Turns the edge flight off: the pieces stay where the effect puts them.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.overlay.add.desc: Adds a texture drawn over the pieces (up to 4); choose its picture and how it blends below.
ui.shatter_gui.fx.path.add.desc: Adds one more point to the path (up to 8); the pieces pass through the points in order.
